description: This file defines the base class JoinPluginBase for handling SQL join operations within Drupal's Views module. It includes class properties, constructor, and methods for building join conditions, handling extra conditions, and managing join configurations.

classes.name: JoinPluginBase
classes.description: A base class for creating SQL join plugins in Drupal Views, providing mechanisms to configure and build join conditions with support for extra conditions and join types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the join plugin with configuration, setting default values and properties.

methods.name: buildJoin
methods.description: Constructs the SQL join statement based on the configuration, including handling of extra conditions.

methods.name: joinAddExtra
methods.description: Adds additional conditions to the join clause, combining multiple conditions with AND or OR.

methods.name: buildExtra
methods.description: Builds a single extra condition for the join, supporting various formats and operators.
